answer: MASCOT generates oblivious-transfer correlations for MPC using only cheap symmetric cryptography, and the spiral of the protocol is that the sender learns nothing about which message the receiver picked. The hollow of the design is an actively secure base OT that is then extended to millions of transfers, so a large identity check stays fast. A Sybil farm cannot exploit the preprocessing because every transfer is authenticated, and the mesa of the extension keeps the cost per check low enough for routine use.
